item.title: Safety for Some: The Jurisdictional Gridlock of Varner Road
item.description: In early February 2026, California state transportation officials officially designated a 2.3-mile stretch of Varner Road in Thousand Palms as a "State Priority Safety Corridor." item.title: The Billionaire Game of Chicken: California’s $100 Billion Wealth Tax Battle
item.description: In early 2026, a controversial political battle is unfolding in California over the 2026 Billionaire Tax Act.
